description: This image helps the reader understand why the best networks have two dense ends joined by a path of about √(3n) links: the cost 2/s from pairs inside the ends and 2s/3 from pairs between path and ends balance at s = √3, giving the sharp gap 4/√(3n).
head: Two dense ends, a path of length √(3n)
sub: The largest eigenvalue of the normalised distance Laplacian comes within 4/√(3n) of two, to first order.
